pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0127 first-release completion on a current-main branch. Restores the Native 2D authoring-window asset-manifest integration after branch synchronization, fixes the Launcher proving-template Clippy regression, and advertises the already-implemented Native 2D typed-document MCP handlers through the canonical capability-derived descriptor inventory with regression coverage.

The branch retains the existing Native 2D runtime, authoring, Editor, CLI/MCP-host, physics, rendering, scripting, event bridge, and first-party Launcher proving-project implementation.
